comparison_to_prior_snapshot.state: Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN

interpretation: The decline is still primarily deleveraging/position closure because OI is falling with price and CVD. This is not the fresh-bearish-leverage signature (Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI UP). However, structure has weakened because price is trading below/around dOpen and below dPOC. Flow alone is not enough to justify averaging down.

management.existing_small_long: Can be treated as exploratory only while price is below dPOC/dOpen.
management.resting_lower_limits: Pause/cancel blind averaging orders until price response confirms support. Re-arm only after a sweep/stabilization/reclaim sequence or clear absorption with price acceptance.
management.bullish_rearm: Reclaim dOpen 77215 and preferably dPOC 77350, then hold/retest while CVD stabilizes or rises and OI does not expand bearishly.
management.bearish_transition: If price continues lower, CVD falls, and OI turns UP, classify as fresh bearish leverage expansion and invalidate the long-add thesis.
management.deep_support_reference: dVAL 76820 is the next major value reference but is not a blind buy level.

lesson: Price response dominates. Falling OI makes the selloff less bearish than fresh short expansion, but a structurally failed reclaim means no automatic long. Do not confuse deleveraging with a confirmed bottom.
